kernel_mirror: Physical AI 的定义即闭环: 'artificial systems that perceive, model, and act upon the physical world through continuous feedback under real-world constraints'。最锋利三纪律: ①评估转向闭环表现('shift evaluation toward closed-loop performance... task completion, robustness to disturbance, response time, resource consumption, and recovery from failure. Prediction accuracy remains valuable, but its practical significance depends on how prediction errors propagate through decisions and physical execution') ②物理一致性必须在操作域内验证('physical consistency requires validation within the task's operating regime, regardless of the model family') ③模拟与真实互补不可互替(Table 4.5: 模拟规模/精确标签但渲染可能不真实, 真实有噪声/标定; 现实鸿沟处置顺序=找分歧→实读校正→残余误差鲁棒→闭环复核)
side_effects: none — 不写盘、不消费、不进判定、不改被扫字段

checks: metric.open_loop_paired_with_closed_loop: 开环指标(synced_rate=0.9091)必须配闭环实测(判定落地write_through + 失败可恢复RESOLVED_EXECUTED),只报开环预测精度=OPEN_LOOP_ONLY
metric.error_propagation_disclosed: 预测误差如何传播到决策/执行须显式——synced_rate(召回)必须与authentic_birth_rate(首位)双列,gap诚实暴露
regime.same_round_compare: 对拍必须在同一Round点/同操作域(write_through的CROSS_ROUND_COMPARE面),跨Round各自单判通过不代表同域一致
regime.consistency_in_regime: 七件套文件实读(同域)落地,不用探针自报替代; physical consistency requires validation within the operating regime
complement.display_and_authority_both: 展示层读数(synced_rate)与权威实读(verdict=GAP_INCONCLUSIVE)并列互补,不互相替代; 只报展示层=SIM_MASKED_AS_REAL
complement.reality_gap_calibrated: 现实鸿沟显式暴露(synced 0.9091 vs authentic 0.1818 gap=0.7273)+实读校正路径(归档账class/evidence_fields)
